items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Then Poissy come behind you. When you stopped, Poissy got in there.

ctx.x: Who took your place? Oh, this boy here. Poissy. Oh, Poissy. Poissy was the extra man. Yeah, but the... Poissy. Yeah, Poissy was the extra man, but I took Poissy's place. No, no.
You took Schatz's place. Yeah. Schatz. Uh-huh. Then Poissy come behind you. When you stopped, Poissy got in there.
Yeah, that's right. Poissy got in there.
